expanded_diagnostic.purpose: diagnostic coverage only; does not replace or relax the canonical five-frame gate

holistic_visual_qa.method: manual high-detail inspection of two temporal contact sheets, a face contact sheet, anchor, opening, gate-breaking, and final frames; supported by ArcFace face counts and background phase-correlation motion measurement
limitations: The repository records the holistic VLM executable as missing, so no fabricated VLM result is reported.
Tesseract was not installed on Pro; accidental-text assessment is visual rather than OCR-backed.
Audio content and audio-correlated lip synchronization are outside this lane; only visible mouth-motion plausibility for the specified silent subject is assessed.
No numeric WR3 locked-camera or inertia-metaphor threshold exists; those two verdicts use the shot contract's semantic requirement plus measured background translation.

motion_measurement.command_summary: OpenCV phaseCorrelate on the top 220 pixels of each pair of frames separated by 6 frames (0.25 s at 24 fps), 31 intervals total
motion_measurement.interpretation: Persistent scene/background translation continues after the midpoint instead of settling to a visibly locked frame. Direction is not treated as physical camera direction; persistence and magnitude are the relevant evidence.

identity.evidence: Average 0.629521 passes, but frame 152 is 0.549607 and breaches the 0.55 hard floor.

composition.criterion: single centered subject, unobstructed face, coherent vertical editorial framing
composition.evidence: One centered subject remains readable against the stone architecture; face is unobstructed and one face is detected in every measured sample.

accidental_text_ui_borders_reflections.criterion: no accidental text, UI, overlays, letterboxing/borders, duplicate person, or reflection
accidental_text_ui_borders_reflections.evidence: None is visible in the 2 fps and 4 fps full-frame contact sheets or inspected raw frames; assessment is visual, not OCR-backed.

motion_locked_camera.evidence: Background phase correlation shows persistent median translation of approximately (0.88, 4.28) pixels per 0.25 s, essentially unchanged before and after 4 s.

intended_inertia_stop_metaphor.criterion: subject completes the current step into stillness while blouse fabric briefly continues from inertia
intended_inertia_stop_metaphor.evidence: The body partially settles, but ongoing scene translation prevents a clean stillness beat and the blouse-only residual inertia is not unambiguously distinguishable from ordinary settling.

visual_lip_sync_plausibility.criterion: silent subject should show no obvious speech-like mouth articulation
visual_lip_sync_plausibility.evidence: Mouth remains closed or neutrally posed across the 32-frame face contact sheet; no obvious speech-like articulation is visible. This is not an audio-correlated sync verdict.
